<think>
The compilation errors stem from a new required “location” path parameter introduced in the v2 Cloud DNS API. Previously, methods like managedZones.create/get/list, resourceRecordSets.list, projects.get, and changes.create/get/list accepted only project (and other resource IDs). In v2, these now require an additional String argument for location, typically "global". 

To fix the client, update all affected method invocations to pass "global" as the new location parameter:
- ManagedZones: create/get/list/delete now need (projectId, "global", ...)
- ResourceRecordSets: list needs (projectId, "global", zoneName)
- Projects: get needs (projectId, "global")
- Changes: create/get/list need (projectId, "global", zoneName, ...)

No function signatures need to change; only method calls are updated. This should compile against the new API without altering functionality.
</think>
